hooks.10: two pages over ?net=local in one context (the host / join menu flow of e2e-net-lib hostAndJoin, startMode, until), RemotePlayer.allowTeleport, the remote avatar rig headNode, Vector3.TransformCoordinates for the crop
hooks.01-03: window.__app.current (GameState): player.controller.teleport, photoFreeze / photoCamera (photo mode), vision.set("off"); the spot planner: nav (NavGrid cells), ballistics.cast + world.lightField.levelAt (the lamp-audit framing rays); screenshot luma histograms
hooks.04: world.level.lights (LightRegistry), ballistics.cast (the nearest wall face and the ceiling over the lamp), photo camera; ceiling luma
hooks.05: player teleport with the rig shown, world.charShadows (silhouette slots, stats()), Epic pass: app.quality.setOverride({ preset: "epic" })
hooks.06: world.level.boxes / world.layout.props (crate / rack), world.doors.setOpen (the leaf open), the lamp registry
hooks.07: enemyMgr.spawn (passive grunts), Enemy.torchOverride (the coop-torches test hook), enemyMgr.torchesOn, world.doors.setOpen(false); on / off screenshot diff
hooks.08: stealth.shotRay (the round on the fitting; shootLight fallback), the circuit wall switch item (StealthSystems switch onUse = the player toggle; LightRegistry.setGroup fallback), GameState.lightLevel (the HUD meter), LightRegistry.restore
hooks.09: vision.set("night" / "thermal"), enemyMgr.spawn (a warm body in view); the darkest room from the audit file
hooks.probe: GameState.lightLevel (the meter) vs world.lightField.bodyLevel (shots-ctcourse parity); World.addLightProbe grey card + centre display-luma read-back against the L5 band (e2e-darkness)
hooks.bake: World.lightInfo() (bake ms, lamp visibility bytes), BakedLamps.atlasDims (R8 atlas), a fresh context per preset (?gfx=epic / ?gfx=low: a cold bake)
hooks.perf: guard-cap pageSpawn (24 passive grunts in a wedge in front of the camera) + loop.onFrameEnd frame intervals + EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 GPU ms, in an E2E_UNCAP=1 browser, 1920x1080

deviations: No `__game` hook exists on this commit: `window.__app.current` is the game (every shot script uses it); `__course` is not needed (no course-only shot).
campusOps has no Workshop room: the Workshop unit is the Sector Ops Workshop on warehouseOps (room `workshop`, the 4.78 wall-arc room). Maps without sectors are one unit, `all`.

Parity probe: there is no hook reading the shader light level back on this commit (BakedLamps.volumeAt needs the editor-only volume; the e2e-lightbake parity probe named in lr16-5b-build.md is not in the script). The probe is the meter vs the light field (shots-ctcourse, |diff| < 0.02) plus the grey card display luma checked against the L5 band of its field level (e2e-darkness).

Auto graphics = `?gfx=user&detect=1` (the saved defaults; automation skips the detection without detect=1). The starred shots (05, 07) are taken again at Epic through app.quality.setOverride, skipped when Auto already is Epic.
Realistic is the only light model (LR16a removed the switch): nothing to set.

Each map's own guards are removed and its security cameras paused (security.fixedUpdate replaced), so no alarm stage changes the lights mid-shot; the guards of shots 07 / 09 and the perf cells are spawned passive grunts.
Shot 09: the thermal ghost through a shut door is LR16-6 (not built): the note says what thermal shows (a warm guard is placed in view).
Shot 10: vision is never sent to the partner (D8): what A sees of B's goggles is the same in every mode of B.
Pass / flag: 01-03, 04, 07, 08, 09, 10 and the probe have cheap automated checks; 05 and 06 (shadow softness) are "review": the sheet is the result.
